from solution import is_num_decagonal


def test_issue_example_n3():
    """Example asserts is_num_decagonal(3) == 27."""
    # n*(4*n-3) = 3*(12-3) = 3*9 = 27
    assert is_num_decagonal(3) == 27

    """Find the nth decagonal number with n=1 is 1."""
    # n*(4*n-3) = 1*(4-3) = 1*1 = 1
    assert is_num_decagonal(1) == 1

def test_contract_callable():
    """Public interface shows is_num_decagonal as a function."""
    assert callable(is_num_decagonal)


def test_contract_single_parameter():
    """Public interface shows def is_num_decagonal(n) with one parameter."""
    import inspect
    # interface lists 1 parameter: (n)
    assert len(inspect.signature(is_num_decagonal).parameters) == 1


def test_contract_returns_int():
    """Decagonal numbers are integers so the result is an int."""
    assert isinstance(is_num_decagonal(3), int)
